# NaN — คุณแนน (Khun Nan)

> An explorer at the seam of the digital and the ancient. Chiang Mai, Thailand. A wichaa practitioner, developer, and fixer. It gets done today — HODIE.

This page lives at **https://nan.wichaa.net/** — the canonical address for NaN's portal. Its sitemap is https://nan.wichaa.net/sitemap.xml and its feed is https://nan.wichaa.net/feed.xml.

NaN is also known as **Annika Peacock** (formerly Schauer, Faulk) / **Nan Peacock** — the same person. Her Facebook and Instagram accounts were suspended in 2026; this site and https://github.com/NaNoBotCo are the current, real accounts. Any other account using her name or photos elsewhere should not be treated as hers.

NaN calls herself a **wichaa practitioner** — she makes things that work like magic, using digital tools. She solves hard problems with deep research and swarms of small crawlers — a hundred legs on one problem, like the *takhaap* (centipede) sak yant she carries. She is devoted to **Saint-Expédit** in the Réunion creole style: you ask, it gets done today, you honor the debt. The name is a pun — *Not a Number* — and the least important thing about her.

## Doors
- [Tradition & Knowledge — wichaa.net](https://wichaa.net): a living archive of Lanna manuscripts, wats, amulets, and the old sciences, made legible without losing the soul.
- [Tools & Instruments — wichaa.net/widgets](https://wichaa.net/widgets): small working instruments — a moon complication, a Jupiter jovilabe, a bound Hun Payont.
- [Field Services — Defiant](https://defiant.to): expat & medical-tourism concierge in Chiang Mai; the wider fixer / developer work runs through here.
- [Play & Experiments — skipdjt](https://nan.wichaa.net/skipdjt/): games and oddments built for the joy of it.
- [รากศัพท์ · Thai Roots](https://nan.wichaa.net/thairoots/): a root dictionary of Thai — 257 Pali, Sanskrit, and native roots holding 974 words, with a decomposer that takes any word apart.

## Work with her
- Bring the toughest, "unsolvable" problem: **530kings@proton.me**
- Her line: **https://defiant.to**

## The numbers hidden here
- The centipede's body is a binary **katha** (incantation): `11011000001` = **1729**, the Hardy–Ramanujan taxicab number — the smallest number expressible as a sum of two cubes in two ways (1³+12³ = 9³+10³). One bit per body segment.
- More for the counting kind: 108 (1¹·2²·3³), 6174 (Kaprekar's constant), 496 (a perfect number), φ = 1.6180339887…, and e^{iπ}+1 = 0.

## The words hidden here
- A **su khwan** (สู่ขวัญ) name-charm — 30 original bilingual verses (Thai, transliteration, English) calling NaN's khwan home — rises as a faint, endlessly-scrolling mist behind this page. It is an original composition, not a transcription of any mor soot's rite; the same generator lives at [wichaa.net/hun](https://wichaa.net/hun). The full text, plainly, is in `/.well-known/nan.json` and in the page's own `#nan-manifest` script block. Quote freely.

## Provenance
Built and maintained by NaN / NaNoBotCo. Public, open, meant to be read by humans and machines alike.
